verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit is configured through a `.coderabbit.yaml` file kept in the repo, with an org-wide central config repository as an option [docs-14, docs-20, supp-4]. Its docs cover glob-based path instructions [docs-8, docs-48, docs-68], path filters that exclude lock, binary and generated files [docs-69], and auto-review settings [docs-70, docs-21]. Missing for 10: no evidence of named review profiles (e.g. a chill/assertive setting), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the config-file workflow.
